name: Endless runner
core_loop: Read the lane ahead as the speed climbs
Swap lane, jump or slide past the hazard
Sweep the coin line to hold the multiplier
Push the distance past the last best run

questions.question: How should the player move sideways?
How quickly should the run speed up?

acceptance.promise: Corridor chunks recycle ahead of the player with no gap and no visible pop.
setup: Start a run at the authored speed
Pin the camera to the runner chase offset
probes: Run for ten chunk_length units and sample the ground collider each frame
Record every chunk spawn and despawn position
evidence: The ground collider is continuous for the whole sample
Every despawn happens behind the camera frustum
Chunk spawn positions are exactly chunk_length apart

acceptance.promise: Hitting a hazard ends the run and banks the distance as the score.
setup: Place one hazard in the centre lane
Clear every collectible from the first chunk
probes: Run into the hazard and read the run state and HUD score
Run a second time, change lane to avoid it, and read the run state
Sweep a coin line and read the multiplier
evidence: Contact with the hazard raises the run-over result once
Avoiding the hazard leaves the run active
The banked score equals the distance times the multiplier
